evidence.evidence_text: Thus, the inability to identify uninformative tokens undermines the supposed efficiency gains from pruning.To address this, we propose Navigation-Aware Pruning (NAP), which uses navigation-specific traits to simplify the pruning process by pre-filtering tokens into foreground and background.
We also extract navigation-relevant instructions using a Large Language Model.
Large models achieve strong performance on Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) tasks, but are costly to run in resource-limited environments.
